generationInputs.prompt: A sophisticated and conceptual book cover design. The central visual is an illustration of multiple interconnected light points, forming a delicate constellation or fluid network. Light emanates softly from the center, casting a gentle glow. The background features a dark gradient, shifting from a deep midnight blue at the top to a muted amethyst or slate gray towards the bottom, creating depth. The light points and lines are rendered in pure white, silver, and a soft golden-yellow, creating a luminous effect. The title "La Ciencia de la Atracción" is positioned clearly, followed by "La Lealtad y la Felicidad" and "en Relaciones Abiertas para Hombres Gay." The author's name, "Luis Angel Maciel", is at the bottom, all in elegant serif fonts.
